summary: Capital Southwest Corporation filed an 8-K to report adding RBC Capital Markets as a sales agent under its existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The registrant entered into an equity distribution agreement with RBC on August 7, 2026, replacing and amending prior agreements with Jefferies, Raymond James, Citizens JMP, and B. Riley. Under the program, the company may sell up to $2.0 billion of common stock, with about $1.1 billion remaining as of the filing date. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, and no restructuring, acquisition, or other exceptional event is disclosed.
